# Adrapid

Adrapid is a tool designed for efficient creation of digital marketing visuals, including banners, images, videos, and HTML5 content, utilizing reusable templates and offering automation through a REST API.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/adrapid/.

## Actions

- **Get API info** (read-only): Retrieve api root information.
- **Get user and API info** (read-only): Get user account and api information.
- **List Banners** (read-only): List all banners and their statuses.
